name: Rust toolchain
description: rustup with the stable toolchain, rustfmt and clippy, from the official sh.rustup.rs installer. Wrappers on the tools bin set RUSTUP_HOME, so cargo and rustc work in any box.
install:
t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs -o "$t" && RUSTUP_HOME={{prefix}}/rustup CARGO_HOME={{prefix}}/cargo sh "$t" -y --no-modify-path --profile minimal -c rustfmt -c clippy --default-toolchain stable; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit "$rc"; mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin && for p in {{prefix}}/cargo/bin/*; do n=$(basename "$p"); printf '#!/bin/sh
export RUSTUP_HOME={{prefix}}/rustup
exec {{prefix}}/cargo/bin/%s "$@"
' "$n" > {{prefix}}/bin/$n && chmod +x {{prefix}}/bin/$n; done
uninstall: for p in {{prefix}}/cargo/bin/*; do rm -f {{prefix}}/bin/$(basename "$p"); done; rm -rf {{prefix}}/cargo {{prefix}}/rustup
